## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3 (continued): GitHubPRDefenseStore (review-github-defense-store.sh) reads/writes defenses keyed by (pr_number, commit_sha). Existing PR-keyed defenses remain readable via the sentinel-pr_number rule.

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/scripts/test-review-github-defense-store-pr-keyed.sh`.

**Test approach**: parallel to T5 but for the GitHubPRDefenseStore backend. Given a fixture PR API (mocked via gh-api wrapper or fixture file): writing a defense with explicit pr_number=42 produces a PR comment containing the new key fingerprint; reading with --pr-number 42 returns it; reading with --pr-number 99 does not return it but DOES return legacy/sentinel records.

Test fails RED because GitHubPRDefenseStore script does not yet accept pr_number key.

Update `.test-index` with RED marker `[test_review_github_defense_store_pr_keyed]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `tests/scripts/test-review-github-defense-store-pr-keyed.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker only) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-review-github-defense-store-pr-keyed.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-review-github-defense-store-pr-keyed.sh
- [ ] Test is initially RED
  Verify: ! bash tests/scripts/test-review-github-defense-store-pr-keyed.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_review_github_defense_store_pr_keyed\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet\xe2\x86\x92opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
